title: Kai explains Farming and Fishing

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Care for more tourism achievement tips?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Care for more tourism achievement tips?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: I'm impressed. You can remember your name. What next? Your age?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm impressed. You can remember your name. What next? Your age?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: More specifically, do you have a problem with me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: More specifically, do you have a problem with me?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: More specifically, do you have a problem with me?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: More specifically, do you have a problem with me?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: I... don't spend a lot of time talking to people offline. It can make me seem a little... stiff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I... don't spend a lot of time talking to people offline. It can make me seem a little... stiff.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: And I don't enjoy acting like a tour guide. This job is beneath me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I don't enjoy acting like a tour guide. This job is beneath me.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Orchestrating DDOS attacks on C-level security servers with quantum bot nets. And cranberry juice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Orchestrating DDOS attacks on C-level security servers with quantum bot nets. And cranberry juice.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I also love orchestrating DDOS attacks on C-level security servers with quantum bot nets too!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I also love orchestrating DDOS attacks on C-level security servers with quantum bot nets too!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I also love orchestrating DDOS attacks on C-level security servers with quantum bot nets too!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I also love orchestrating DDOS attacks on C-level security servers with quantum bot nets too!

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Yes, well, lets both be professional about this. I still have a job to do. Have you been fishing or farming?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, well, lets both be professional about this. I still have a job to do. Have you been fishing or farming?

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Good. Finding rare fish will open up new locations via your visa achievements.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. Finding rare fish will open up new locations via your visa achievements.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Yes, that too. The more plants you cultivate, the more we can check off on your achievement list.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, that too. The more plants you cultivate, the more we can check off on your achievement list.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: Don't drink the yellow water that comes out of the pipes in The Marrow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Don't drink the yellow water that comes out of the pipes in The Marrow.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I mean any more tips for unlocking new zones!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean any more tips for unlocking new zones!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I mean any more tips for unlocking new zones!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I mean any more tips for unlocking new zones!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: As long as you don't call me that weird name again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As long as you don't call me that weird name again.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: As long as you don't call me that weird name again.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: As long as you don't call me that weird name again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The weird name you keep using.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The weird name you keep using.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The weird name you keep using.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The weird name you keep using.

nodes.speaker: Kai Galosh
nodes.text: You know you can just ask Ava? She has a better memory than most humans, and a FAR better memory than yours.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know you can just ask Ava? She has a better memory than most humans, and a FAR better memory than yours.
